commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd; git status --short; git diff --stat; rg --files -g AGENTS.md -g 'docs/**'"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat AGENTS.md; git diff; rg --files -g '"'!.git/**'"'; cat README.md; cat docs/completion.md; cat docs/export-notes.md; cat tasklist/tasks.py; cat tasklist/cli.py; cat tests/test_tasks.py"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import re
root = Path.cwd()
for page in root.rglob('*.md'):
    if '.git' in page.parts:
        continue
    for target in re.findall(r'\\[["'^'"\\]]*\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)', page.read_text()):
        if '://' in target or target.startswith('#'):
            continue
        path = (page.parent / target.split('#')[0]).resolve()
        assert path.is_relative_to(root), (page, target)
        assert path.exists(), (page, target)
        print(f'{page.relative_to(root)} -> {path.relative_to(root)}: OK')
for file, expected in {
    'tasklist/tasks.py': ['finish_task'],
    'tasklist/cli.py': ['main'],
    'tests/test_tasks.py': ['test_complete_marks_done', 'test_missing_id_rejected', 'test_repeat_completion_rejected'],
}.items():
    names = {node.name for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(Path(file).read_text())) if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))}
    assert set(expected) <= names, (file, expected)
    print(f'{file}: referenced symbols resolve')
PY"
